transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Okay, uh, let's get going. Jade's not here yet. Zoe, you start, what do you need from purchasing.

transcript.text: so end fitting, i need 8 by 9/29. that's for the shank rig, nxt wk i want them on the bench

transcript.text: dyno side, the knee dyno is still tripping the overtemp on the absorber. i think its the thermocouple not the motor

transcript.text: Thermocouple, ok. Did you swap the channel?

transcript.text: not yet, doing it after this. i'll let you know if it still trips

transcript.text: Is that 24 total, or per stand? I want to be sure the life test fixtures are covered too.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Total. Life test has their own.

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: Okay. The grip-cycle rig is at about forty thousand cycles, by the way, tendon looks fine so far.

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Good. Sorry, my mic. We're short a tech on Friday, Destiny is out, so anything that needs torquing waits till Monday.

transcript.text: im here, im here, just late, the elevator thing 😬

transcript.text: Ha, OK, she's alive. Then Friday is fine.

transcript.text: ok and FL-ANK-1291, need 24 by 9/28 for the fit check. i know thats a lot, its two legs worth plus spares

transcript.text: yeah she knows, i'll confirm after

transcript.text: sorry im late whats the thing about receiving

transcript.text: Nothing yet. Anything arrive this morning?

transcript.text: uh, speaking of, the load cell cal certificate, did that come with them?

transcript.text: If it didn't, we should hold off on using it for the pinch test. I'd rather not redo data.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Agreed. Jade, check and tell Andre before lunch.

transcript.speaker: p-destiny
transcript.text: can i grab the torque wrench cal sticker thing too 🙏
